sentence: This project builds a gene therapy that uses meganucleases to control latent infection by a virus that causes genital disease.
This project develops chemical methods to find out how cellular machinery turns human genes off and on.
This project tests whether small molecules that break down a protein can treat advanced colon cancer that has spread, alone and with chemotherapy.
This project studies whether ultrasound and microbubble contrast agents can help gene therapy vectors deliver genes into cells of the heart.
This project studies how mutations that cause hypertrophic cardiomyopathy change the forces made by myosin and heart cells, using modeling tools.
This project looks for proteins linked to breast cancer risk by studying breast tissue and testing what the proteins do in cells.
This project uses mice that differ in how gene mutations affect the face to study the gene networks that guide facial development.
This project studies how to improve the firing of Purkinje neurons in spinocerebellar ataxias and links that firing to cell degeneration.
This project studies how endogenous opioids in the dorsal raphe nucleus affect motivated behaviors during chronic pain.
This project compares how motor cortex controls vocal behaviors in singing mice and lab mice, using electrophysiology and optogenetic manipulations.
This project studies how natural and synthetic cannabinoids affect endothelial function, neuroinflammation and cognition, with a focus on one receptor.
This project develops a plasma-based sterilization system that cleans medical devices such as endoscopes without length limits or toxic gas emissions.
This project studies how alternative splicing helps create different types of neuron in the mouse cortex.
This project runs a service center that gives cancer immunology researchers tools such as imaging mass cytometry for studying immune cells in mouse models.
This project studies how the B cell co-receptor complex works and is regulated, and builds tools to change B cell function.
This project screens for compounds that promote remyelination to repair white matter injury in premature babies.
This project studies how nervous system reactions and adversity relate to two subtypes of callous-unemotional traits in young children.
This project tests a drug in people with bronchiolitis obliterans syndrome and uses airway organoids to find what the immune system attacks.
This project keeps a repository of muscle tissue and cells from patients with neuromuscular disorders and provides diagnostic services for muscular dystrophy research.
This project develops methods to reconstruct and predict gene regulatory networks and to show how genetic variants disrupt them.
